title: Obsidian Plugins
excerpt: This is a list of Obsidian plugins I use and which I would like you to use also, so that we can all profit from the same functionalities: Suggested Admonition Advanced Tables Autom
markdown:
This is a list of Obsidian plugins I use and which I would like you to use also, so that we can all profit from the same functionalities:

**Suggested**
- Admonition
- Advanced Tables
- Automatic Tags
- Banners
- Custom Frames
- ~~Dangling Links~~
- Dataview
- ~~Dialogue~~
- Dice Roller
- File Explorer Note Count
- Folder notes
- Kanban
- Lazy Plugin Loader
- Leaflet
- ~~Omnisearch~~
- Pane Relief
- **Relay**
- Second Window
- Style Settings
- Supercharged Links
- Various Complements
- Vault Full Statistics
- Waypoint

**Optional / GM only necessary**
- 3D Graph
- Iconize
- Inline Checkbox Groups
- JSON/CSV Importer
- Multi Properties
- Templater
- Text Generator
- Vault Statistics

**Testing Phase**
- Calendarium
- Edit History
- ~~Excalidraw~~
- Fantasy Content Generator
- Fantasy name generator
- Find orphaned files and broken links
- Meta Bind
- Note Linker
- Pending notes

**Possibly interesting plugins**
- AI LLM
- April's Automatic Timelines
- Aut-O-Backups
- Auto Embed
- Auto Split
- Auto Tag
- Copilot
- Default New Tab Page
- Fantasy Statblocks
- File Share
- Force note view mode
- Generic Initiative Tracker
- Hierarchical Backlinks
- Image Converter
- Initiative Tracker
- Link Converter
- Regex Pipeline
- Share Note
- Smart Connections
- Solo RPG Toolkit
- Spoiler Block
- Spoilers
- Trash Explorer
- Waypoint

**Not suggested plugins**
- Cypher

- Meld Encrypt
